title: Diwali 2026 greeting: one lamp lights the next

lines.say: Diwali comes on the darkest night of the month.
lines.show: Diwali comes on the darkest night of the month.

lines.say: We draw a rangoli at the door, and light one lamp.
lines.show: We draw a rangoli at the door, and light one lamp.

lines.say: Then the next one, from the first.
lines.show: Then the next one, from the first.

lines.say: A flame gives its light, and loses nothing.
lines.show: A flame gives its light, and loses nothing.

lines.say: Happy Diwali, from all of us at Your Rider.
lines.show: Happy Diwali, from all of us at Yourider.
